statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r is the maximum of the set of values points[j][0] - points[i][0] over all ordered pairs (i,j) with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= j < n, points[i][0] < points[j][0], and no k with 0 <= k < n satisfying points[i][0] < points[k][0] < points[j][0]; if there is no such pair (equivalently, all x-coordinates are equal), then r = 0.
preconditions: n = len(points); 2 <= n <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9.

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: n = len(points); 2 <= n <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, 0 <= r <= 10^9.
preconditions: n = len(points); 2 <= n <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= (max over 0 <= i < n of points[i][0]) - (min over 0 <= i < n of points[i][0]).
preconditions: n = len(points); 2 <= n <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if points[i][0] = points[j][0] for every i,j with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n (that is, all x-coordinates are equal).
preconditions: n = len(points); 2 <= n <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r and r > 0, there exist indices p and q with 0 <= p < n and 0 <= q < n such that points[p][0] < points[q][0], points[q][0] - points[p][0] = r, and no k with 0 <= k < n satisfies points[p][0] < points[k][0] < points[q][0].
preconditions: n = len(points); 2 <= n <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i,j with 0 <= i < n, 0 <= j < n, points[i][0] < points[j][0], and no k with 0 <= k < n and points[i][0] < points[k][0] < points[j][0], we have points[j][0] - points[i][0] <= r.
preconditions: n = len(points); 2 <= n <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i,j with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n such that points[j][0] - points[i][0] > r, there exists k with 0 <= k < n and points[i][0] < points[k][0] < points[j][0].
preconditions: n = len(points); 2 <= n <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, let y_0 < y_1 < ... < y_{m-1} be the strictly increasing list of distinct values among points[0][0], ..., points[n-1][0]. If m = 1, then r = 0. If m >= 2, then r = max over 0 <= t < m-1 of (y_{t+1} - y_t).
preconditions: n = len(points); 2 <= n <= 10^5; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9.

statement: Whenever the function returns results r on points and r' on points', if the set of distinct x-coordinates appearing among points equals the set of distinct x-coordinates appearing among points', then r = r'.
preconditions: Both points and points' satisfy: n = len(points) (respectively n' = len(points')) with 2 <= n <= 10^5, for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9; and the same for points' with n'.

statement: Whenever the function returns results r on points and r' on points', if every distinct x-coordinate appearing among points also appears among points' (i.e., the set of distinct x-coordinates of points is a subset of that of points'), then r' <= r.
preconditions: Both points and points' satisfy: n = len(points) (respectively n' = len(points')) with 2 <= n <= 10^5, for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9; and the same for points' with n'.
